title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 19484, May 25, 2006>

(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) (Transitional Measures concerning the Terms of Office of Honorary Mayors and Heads of Gun Filling Vacancies) The term of office of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun commissioned to fill a vacancy as at the time this Decree enters into force shall expire on June 24, 2007.
